contract.loadedActivation: Presentation installation also adopts an already-loaded registered locked license page. Existing window traversal, host metadata/class/getter/lifecycle ABI guards and LBXApply are retained. No controller/root creation or original admission callback.
contract.preservation: Original license input, button, error, delegate, targets/actions, disabled state, root/children and load count are unchanged. Repeat installation retains one source form and its entered code; rendering sends no activation, validation or saved-metadata request and constructs no admitted navigation.
contract.upgrade: External preflight and incoming preinst refuse any present fixed source installation, pairing, configuration, pending leaf or external marker, including dangling links, before package replacement. Parent safety must be observed before absence. Established/partial source state has no supported image migration.
contract.authority: All-absent state permits only the existing pinned upgrade checks. It never authorizes first preparation, runs the initializer, resets/adopts data or widens fresh-install support. Ordinary service startup remains existing-only; one-shot paired establishment and licensing are unchanged.
contract.limits: Upgrade guard is an instantaneous read-only package check, not an atomic lock spanning dpkg or protection against a concurrently acting root administrator. Synthetic UI acceptance is not owner locked-page/default endpoint or fresh customer acceptance.
